resources.string: Analyze a downloaded track for possible correction. When a clear correction is found, save an optional enhanced copy and choose which version to play. The original always stays saved.

Analyze a downloaded recording in the background. A separate version is saved only when a clear correction is found; otherwise the original is retained without making a duplicate. The original stays ready to play throughout.
Results depend on the tape. Processing aims to improve clarity while preserving the crowd, musical dynamics, and stereo image. It cannot recreate a missing soundboard recording.
Enhanced copies are lossless and use about 10 MB per minute for typical stereo tracks. Processing may wait for sufficient battery or storage. You can cancel or remove a copy anytime.
Your version choice is used the next time a track starts. Tap Play to start that version now. Current playback is left alone when processing finishes.
Save a track or a full show in Downloads, then return here to create enhanced versions.
